research_notes: Blocked: teaching and legal employment are documented but full-time status and full appointment boundaries remain unavailable after employer post, first speech, local reporting and targeted employment/school searches.
The first speech's explicit full-time schoolteacher reference describes his mother, not Gregg. It is not evidence for his hours.
Do not assign Gabriel Ng's court or public-service roles from the joint employer post to Gregg. Unrelated sports and overseas namesakes were excluded.
Four-year board tenure, study and honorary student-association membership do not count toward employment headlines.
